requirements.description: Create a JSON catalog by extracting every member of each numeric issue-run top-level toolInvocations array, preserving the full invocation object and source issue/index. Organize records under a sorted hierarchy derived from tool identifiers: split on `.` and `__`, retain other characters within tokens, and sort each level lexically. Include the accepted separate report only as a source cross-check when its array duplicates the numeric record, so records are not double-counted; record list totals and source file references.
requirements.intent: Enable browsing and sorting every recorded invocation by its tool root and successive identifier tokens while retaining the original array member and provenance.
